_note: Human-written chart titles for index/series_index.json. The weekly run READS this file and must never write to it. A series with more than one reading and no label here is correctly chartable:false and stays off Tab 2 until a label is added. STEP 10 of the weekly run reports series that need one.
_format: "<series_key>": "<chart title>"  — keys must match series_key in all.json exactly.
_keys_beginning_with_underscore_are_meta: ignore them when looking up a series_key
FR|france|maize|condition_good_excellent: AHDB Arable Market Report — France maize, condition good or excellent
US|great plains|winter_wheat|production|: USDA NASS — US Great Plains winter wheat production
US|northern plains|spring_wheat|conditio: DTN — US Northern Plains spring wheat, condition good or excellent
